attributedString.string:
General
• Fixed issue where symbols that should have been swappable were not

System > Home Screen
• Adjusted all app icon layouts
• Updated status bar symbols and layout
• Updated all app icons

System > Controls
• Updated appearance of Liquid Glass

System > Notifications
• Updated appearance of Liquid Glass
• Adjusted corner radii for expanded notifications
• Added overlays for iPad notification screens
• Renamed symbols to clarify that some notification banners render with light text even in light mode, depending on wallpaper
• Removed background blur for expanded iPad notifications
• Adjusted width of notification banners and expanded notifications
• Added app icon, title, description, and timestamp to expanded notifications

System > Lock Screen Widgets
• Fixed issue where material was not blurring background

System > Widgets
• Added Liquid Glass appearance
• Added Extra Large widget
• Made minor adjustments to widget sizes

System > Home Screen Quick Actions
• Adjusted fill and opacity of light and dark mode screen overlays
• Updated size of selected app icon
• Adjusted position of menu and app icon
• Added Extra Large widget option to menu

System > Lock Screen
• Adjusted position of time
• Updated glass effect for time

System > Windows
• Added window resize control variant for full-screen windows
• Added two-window Example symbol showing active and inactive states with corresponding visual states for toolbar buttons and window controls
• Updated appearance of window controls
• Added inactive window control symbols
• Removed window controls toolbar in full-screen apps

Action Sheets
• Added example Action Sheets for light and dark mode

Alerts
• Removed background frames from Alert Button symbols and applied style directly to the symbol

Buttons
• Added button styles for glass, glass prominent, glass destructive, and glass prominent destructive
• Added disabled states for all glass button styles
• Added small, regular, and large size variants for all glass buttons

Color Wells and Pickers
• Moved iPhone color picker into a medium detent sheet
• Made various small layout and size updates

Date and Time Pickers
• Adjusted size of calendar days
• Adjusted height of collapsed date and time picker controls
• Updated appearance of selected date in day pickers
• Updated layout of date and time pickers
• Changed color of next and previous month buttons from blue to primary label

Keyboards
• Updated layout of keypads and keys
• Created override symbols for the Shift key, Keyboard Switcher, and Return key
• Moved keypads into nested symbols
• Added support for Email, URL, and Web Search keyboard types
• Added support for Decimal and Phone keyboard types

Lists
• Updated swipe action components to match current font and layout metrics
• Added inline symbol and layout swipe action
• Added fill color to list row symbols
• Removed list color from grouped table view symbol to better support swipe actions

Menus
• Renamed Quick Actions to Control Group to better align with SwiftUI
• Fixed issue where menu items were not swappable

Page Controls
• Renamed "with background" to "background" and "default" to "no background"
• Applied primary label color to selected dots and tertiary label color to unselected dots

Popovers
• Replaced uses of "left" and "right" with "leading" and "trailing"

Progress Indicators
• Aligned small, regular, and large indeterminate progress indicator sizes, adding one new size option
• Changed determinate progress indicator height from 6pt to 4pt
• Applied semantic colors to fills and tracks in determinate progress indicators
• Added optional label inside determinate progress indicator

Segmented Controls
• Removed 2, 3, and 4 segment symbol variants; use the 5-segment symbol and hide unneeded segments
• Added disabled and tapped states
• Added large control size

Sheets
• Increased width of half-height sheet

Sidebars
• Extended sidebars to go edge to edge
• Updated material background for sidebars
• Updated separator line for split views in sidebar example symbols
• Added scroll edge effect demonstration to sidebar example symbols
• Changed sidebar buttons to Liquid Glass style and adjusted spacing
• Updated selected state appearance for sidebar

Sliders
• Added pressed and disabled states

Steppers
• Added pressed and disabled states

Tab Bars
• Adjusted appearance of tinted selected tab to better preserve color contrast
• Set iPad tab bar layout to fit
• Fixed incorrect keyboard inset when searching
• Removed extra padding above keyboard when searching
• Added diamond symbol to minimized tab bar to clarify the control's purpose
• Corrected leading and trailing edge insets for tab bar search symbols

Text Fields
• Replaced text field separator symbols by nesting content into a frame with a bottom border

Toolbars
• Increased grabber width from 36pt to 58pt
• Added inactive toolbar button states for inactive windows

Toggles
• Added pressed state
• Added disabled states
• Added accessibility label override

• Updated Numbers app icon to be Numbers Creator Studio icon
• Updated colors of buttons on 2 of 3 empty state examples
• Added clear button to “typing” text field
• Corrected keyboard background specular highlight light source angle
• Updated older status bars on two of the lock screen templates
• Centered iPad Docks
